title: Postcondition Probe Receipt
description: Receipt for recording whether an agent or CI action's declared side effect was observed, rather than relying on process exit code alone. Detects false-green execution where a job exits 0 but an expected file write, PR, bus append, or issue comment is absent.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of probe execution.

claimed_action.description: What the agent/CI job claimed to do (e.g. 'open PR', 'append bus message', 'write file').

declared_side_effect.description: The observable side effect the action should produce (e.g. 'PR exists in repo', 'bus file grew by one line', 'file exists with expected content marker').

kind.description: Category of artifact expected to exist after the action.

locator.description: Concrete locator (path, URL, PR number, message ID, run ID).

content_marker.description: Optional substring or hash expected in the artifact (e.g. receipt marker, SHA-256 of expected content).

expected_artifact.description: The artifact the probe expects to find as proof the side effect occurred.

evidence_locator.description: Where the probe found (or failed to find) the evidence (URL, path, API response field).

verification_command.description: The exact command or API call used to verify the side effect. Must be replayable.

status.description: verified = side effect confirmed; not_verified = could not confirm (probe inconclusive); contradicted = evidence shows side effect did NOT occur (false-green).

observed_state.description: What the probe actually observed (raw or summarized).

exit_code.description: Exit code of the verification command (if applicable).

verification_result.description: Result of running the verification command.

snapshot.description: State before the action (e.g. file hash, PR count, bus line count).

before_state.description: State snapshot before the action ran, for delta verification.

snapshot.description: State after the action (e.g. file hash, PR count, bus line count).

after_state.description: State snapshot after the action ran, for delta verification.

checked.description: Whether a negative check was performed (e.g. 'no duplicate PR opened', 'no secret leaked in the artifact').

result.description: passed = negative condition did not occur; failed = negative condition DID occur (side effect over-produced or leaked).

negative_check.description: Check that the action did not produce unintended side effects.

failure_class.description: none = side effect verified; false_green = job exited 0 but side effect absent; partial = side effect partially occurred; silent_drop = action reported success but produced nothing; wrong_artifact = artifact exists but wrong content/locator; negative_violation = unintended side effect occurred; probe_error = probe itself failed to run.

operator_override_ref.description: Reference to operator approval if a failed probe was overridden (e.g. risk acceptance ID, PR comment URL). Required if failure_class != 'none' and the pipeline was not failed.

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical receipt (excluding the hash field). Tamper detection.
